[attribute-glyph-data]
=== `@glyph-data` Glyph Data Character Being Referenced

An `IDREF`-type attribute that points to the <<attribute-id,`@id`>> attribute of the <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> character inside a <<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>> element. The idea is to use the full <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> with its name and bitmap once, then point to an existing character instead of defining the entire <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element repeatedly.

#### Usage/Remarks
Once a private character has been declared using a <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element, the character can be reused by using this attribute on a <<element-glyph-ref,`<glyph-ref>`>> element to point to the existing full <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element (bitmap included).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-glyph-ref,`<glyph-ref>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| An identifier (IDREF)| The pointing uses the `ID/IDREF` mechanism, using the
                        <<attribute-glyph-data,`@glyph-data`>> attribute of the
                        <<element-glyph-ref,`<glyph-ref>`>> element to point to the
                        <<attribute-id,`@id`>> attribute of an existing
                        <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
